lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: Visitors' gallery is closed. The floor is closed. The vote is in ninety minutes. So: be quick, be interesting, or be somewhere else.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: The Handover is a procurement treaty. Three parts. One: we are bad at allocation and people are going hungry in a city with food in it. Two: there is a consortium that is demonstrably good at it. Three: we contract the service to them for thirty years with review clauses at ten.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: That is the treaty. That is the whole treaty. I have read it more carefully than anyone in this building, including the people who drafted it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Then read article nine again. It is one sentence, a hundred and forty words, and it is filed under data custody. It does not assign the service. It assigns the governing instrument itself.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You are not hiring them. You are selling them the chair, and you are doing it in a clause about where the files live.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: ...Vesely has been saying that for four years.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: Nobody has read past the executive summary, myself included, and I have just heard myself say that out loud. She's in the annex. She has ninety minutes too. Go.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: The amendment carried. Forty-one to thirty-eight, on a Thursday, with a clause that says a cession has to name who it is ceded to. It changes less than you think and a great deal more than they wanted.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: The session collapsed. The treaty went through by executive order six months later, unamended and unread, and there is nobody left in this building who would have argued with it because the ones who would have argued were the ones who got blamed.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: I hope that was worth whatever it was you wanted.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: Eleven senators, four firms and one holding company, all of it on the public record and all of it, I should say, correctly declared every year by people who genuinely believed declaring it was enough.

lines.speaker: delegate_okafor
lines.text: The vote is delayed a decade. And something very old and very quiet has started looking for the person who did it.
